ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AGI Greenpac Limited has formally notified stock exchanges of an upcoming one-on-one meeting with analyst/institutional investor firm Arihant Capital Markets Limited on August 27, 2026. This is a standard regulatory disclosure under SEBI guidelines, allowing the company to discuss performance and strategy which could influence market perception. There are no red flags, with the document merely noting that the meeting schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.
